artifact_requirements.committed_artifacts: Manifest, focused source/tests, compact JSON/Markdown reports, and five deterministic PNG figures only.
artifact_requirements.raw_output_policy: Raw lane, benchmark, archive, log, and cache artifacts remain ignored beneath output_root.
artifact_requirements.scientific_lane_integrity: Exactly 101 scientific samples and 1010 state rows at exact 100-year targets; exactly 11 readable archive snapshots; unique ordered rows; finite state; matching schema and configuration fingerprint; positive callback count; zero nonfinite callback results; exact artifact hashes; telemetry energy exactly reproducible from stored state rows.

audit_before_preregistration.artifact_audit: PASS: all ten completed Step 3d lane summaries and all 51 inventoried lane artifacts matched size and SHA-256; schemas, fingerprints, counts, finite states, callback counters, archives, recomputed energy, and figures passed.

benchmark.projection: Multiply the observed 100-year wall time by 100 and require the projected 10-kyr time to be no more than 3600 seconds.

causal_classification.application: After and only after IAS15 reference qualification, import manifest 15 classification_evidence unchanged, supersede only ias15_tolerance_converged with the manifest-16 qualification result, and call the unchanged manifest-13 classifier.
causal_classification.historical_raw_state_gate: The manifest-13 global 1e-10 and per-body 5e-10 raw pointwise state gates remain reported as historical diagnostics and are not the manifest-16 qualification gate.
causal_classification.source_rules: Every classification rule, WHFast threshold, long-history definition, state/energy definition, and Step 3 status rule is imported from manifest 13 through immutable manifest 15 without modification.
causal_classification.supersedes_only: manifest 13 comparison_definitions.ias15_tolerance_convergence global_scaled_state_rms_max and per_body_scaled_state_rms_max as reference-qualification gates

source_audit.adaptive_mode: PRS23 is the installed default. Its local derivative-based timescale selects dt_new proportional to sqrt(epsilon) for the PRS23 estimator; epsilon controls local adaptive stepping and is not a bound on accumulated global trajectory error.
source_audit.default_epsilon: The exact installed REBOUND 4.6.0 runtime initializes IAS15 epsilon to 1e-9; the upstream IAS15 documentation and Rein-Spiegel paper identify 1e-9 as the machine-precision-oriented default.
source_audit.exact_finish_time: REBOUND integrate exact_finish_time=1 temporarily shortens the final step to hit tmax, retries if IAS15 adapts it downward, then restores the previous proposed timestep.
source_audit.finite_precision: Rein and Spiegel state that epsilon is not the achieved precision and that smaller epsilon can increase accumulated random error by increasing timestep count; phase error may grow faster than energy error at the roundoff floor.
source_audit.local_vs_global: The estimator is local. No source path turns epsilon into a global trajectory-error tolerance.

new_lane.purpose: Independent physical-only IAS15 reference at the exact installed default epsilon.

offline_analysis_definitions.growth: For each absolute component after t=0, report the log-log slope of cumulative RMS against time. Separately least-squares fit amplitudes for fixed t^0.5 and t^1.5 shapes and report normalized RMS residuals; both models are descriptive only and neither is forced.
offline_analysis_definitions.ias15_envelope: At each matched epoch/body/scaled Cartesian component, take the maximum absolute value across the three pairwise default/1e-12/1e-13 differences; then calculate global and per-body RMS using manifest-13 AU and AU/JulianYear scaling.
offline_analysis_definitions.matched_epochs: Exact sample index and exact 100-year target time from 0 through 10000 years; no interpolation.
offline_analysis_definitions.rtn: For each non-Sun body and pair, subtract heliocentric left-minus-right Cartesian state. Build R=r_right/|r_right|, N=(r_right cross v_right)/|r_right cross v_right|, T=N cross R, then project position and velocity differences onto R,T,N.
offline_analysis_definitions.step_distribution: Because the exact installed runtime serializes no every-attempt trace, report distributions of abs(dt_last_done) and abs(proposed dt) over the ten positive-time persisted SimulationArchive snapshots. The 101 scientific endpoint samples are additionally recorded for the new lane.

qualification_rules.integrity: Every default/1e-12/1e-13 lane must pass finite-state, callback, schema, fingerprint, archive, exact count/time, artifact hash, and energy-reconstruction checks.
qualification_rules.qualification: All integrity, frozen energy, frozen a/e, added conservative orientation, phase, angular-momentum, and 10%-of-WHFast envelope gates must pass. Raw-state convergence need not be monotonic once this complete scientific plateau gate passes.

step_accounting.accepted_steps: Use REBOUND Simulation.steps_done from the final serialized SimulationArchive snapshot.
step_accounting.force_evaluations: For this physical-only model each compiled additional-force callback invocation is one observed force-callback evaluation; report the callback total as the force-evaluation count.
step_accounting.rejected_steps_reason: REBOUND 4.6.0 retries IAS15 step_try internally, exposes and serializes successful steps_done but no rejected-attempt counter, and varying predictor iterations prevent deriving rejected attempts from callback totals. Recovering exact rejected counts would require prohibited REBOUND or force-callback instrumentation.
